info.title: WordBase Dictionary
info.description: Multilingual dictionary API: 26 languages, 1.8M+ entries. Definitions, synonyms, translations to English, examples and word relations; English adds IPA pronunciation, syllables, rhymes and Zipf frequency. Optional lang parameter (ISO 639-1/639-3 or English name) on every endpoint; English without lang is unchanged from v1.

get.summary: List all 26 languages with entry counts, sources and licenses
Search words (letterPattern, lettersMin/Max, partOfSpeech, hasDetails, limit/page; syllables and frequency filters are English-only). Add lang to search another language.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language code or name; default en

get.summary: Full word record. Add ?lang=es (etc.) for another language.

One relation per call: definitions, synonyms, antonyms (en), examples, translations, typeOf, hasTypes, partOf, hasParts, memberOf, hasMembers, substanceOf, hasSubstances, similarTo, also, derivation (en), pertainsTo (en), entails, cause, pronunciation, syllables (en), frequency (en), rhymes (en).
Open health: English dataset counts plus per-language entries and senses
